answer: Coordination-Horizon Binding. Each agent must publish a forward schedule of its intended multi-agent collaborations; the protocol admits only schedules whose claimed partners independently confirm within a fixed inlet window. Unconfirmed entries are rejected, so an attacker's clones must each recruit distinct, live counterparties rather than self-confirm. A sparrow-level solo agent pays almost nothing; a sybil swarm pays one verified external coordination per identity, making mass fakery cost linear in real partners.
